highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148, and is a breaking upgrade from v3.
highlights_body: This release rolls up everything from the 4.147.x preview series: variable fonts, animated WebP, color font palettes, zero-copy stream and pixel APIs, WASM improvements, and security-refreshed native libraries. It is a breaking release — review the changes below before upgrading from 3.x.

breaking.title: `new SKFont()` now uses an empty typeface instead of lazy default resolution
breaking.body: Upstream Skia m132 removed the lazy 'resolve default at draw time' pattern. `new SKFont().Typeface` is now `SKTypeface.Empty` (0 glyphs), so `MeasureText("Hello")` returns 0 and nothing is drawn. Detect unset via `font.Typeface.IsEmpty`; construct with `new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default)` for text that draws.

breaking.title: `new SKPaint().Typeface` returns `SKTypeface.Default` instead of `null`
breaking.body: Code that used `paint.Typeface == null` to detect 'no typeface set' no longer fires. Text still draws by default. Use `paint.Typeface.IsEmpty` for the check, or drop it — a usable default is always present.

breaking.title: `SKTypeface.FromFamilyName` returns `Default` instead of `null` on Android for missing families
breaking.body: All platforms now return `SKTypeface.Default` for unknown family names. Code that branched on a `null` return on Android must switch to `SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name, style)`, which still returns `null` on no match.

breaking.title: `SKStream.Move(long)` is now obsolete and throws on out-of-range offsets
breaking.body: The native offset is 32-bit; the `long` overload now uses a checked cast and throws `OverflowException` for values outside `int` range, rather than silently truncating. Switch to `Move(int)`, validating/clamping large values first.

breaking.title: `GRContext.CreateVulkan` terminates the process on Vulkan 1.0 — no longer returns `null`
breaking.body: Skia m139+ requires Vulkan 1.1. Passing a 1.0 instance now calls `SK_ABORT` and kills the process — it cannot be caught. Set `VkApplicationInfo.apiVersion` to `VK_API_VERSION_1_1` and also set `GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion` to the same value; the default `0` is no longer safe.

breaking.title: `GRVkBackendContextNative` — five interop fields removed
breaking.body: Upstream removed `fMinAPIVersion`, `fInstanceVersion`, `fExtensions`, `fFeatures`, and `fOwnsInstanceAndDevice`. Delete those assignments; use `fVkExtensions` in place of `fExtensions` and `fDeviceFeatures`/`fDeviceFeatures2` in place of `fFeatures`.

breaking.title: `GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo` lost value-equality; `GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo` changed type
breaking.body: The type was renamed to `GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo` and a new `Components` field was added. Value-equality (`IEquatable`, `==`, `!=`) was removed. Update equality comparisons and add the new field where you construct the struct.

breaking.title: `SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose` setter is removed
breaking.body: The `protected set` on `IgnorePublicDispose` is gone; the property is now read-only after construction. Update any subclass that assigned to it directly.

breaking.title: Pre-v4 obsolete members promoted to compile errors
breaking.body: APIs marked `[Obsolete(error:true)]` during the 3.x-to-4.x transition — legacy paint text/font state (`SKPaint.Typeface`, `SKPaint.TextSize`, etc.) and the removed enum members — are now compile errors. Migrate to the `SKFont` equivalents.

bullets.detail: The bundled Skia engine advances through m132, m147, and m148, picking up upstream rendering improvements, text-shaping enhancements, and stability fixes across the whole pipeline.
SkiaSharp now exposes Skia's variable font axis API, letting consumers read and set variation axes on a typeface at runtime.
A new `SKWebpEncoder` API encodes multi-frame animated WebP images from a sequence of bitmaps.
New APIs expose the named color palettes embedded in color fonts (COLR/CPAL), allowing consumers to select or override the active palette at draw time.

`SKStream.GetData()` extracts a stream's contents as an `SKData` without copying when the stream is already memory-backed. `SKPixmap.GetPixelSpan` now correctly uses `RowBytes` for stride and the right axis for element offsets.
`SKSamplingOptions` support was added to `SKSurface.Draw` and `SKCanvas.DrawSurface`, and the `HBColor` value type was introduced in HarfBuzzSharp for proper `hb_color_t` representation.
A number of missing C API wrappers were added and naming convention violations were corrected in the public API surface.
A crash when `SKPathBuilder` was garbage-collected before `SKPath` is resolved: the finalizer order is now safe.

bullets.lead: Default typeface resolution fixed on Android API 36+
bullets.detail: `SKTypeface.Default` now falls back to `SKTypeface.Empty` instead of crashing when the system font manager returns null on Android API 36.

bullets.lead: WinUI Projection DLL not found fixed
bullets.detail: Resolves a `DllNotFoundException` for the WinUI projection DLL when consuming SkiaSharp from .NET 9 WinUI apps.

bullets.lead: Android SKGLView blank after tab switch fixed
bullets.detail: Fixed an issue where `SKGLView` stopped rendering after switching tabs in a MAUI `TabBar` on Android.
The handle-registry singleton pattern was overhauled to fix subtle double-dispose and resurrection races when managed wrappers are finalized concurrently.

bullets.lead: Native-compat gate moved to SkiaApi constructor
bullets.detail: The native compatibility check moved from `[ModuleInitializer]` to the `SkiaApi` static constructor, giving better diagnostics and avoiding initialization-order issues.

bullets.lead: Linux Bionic (Android NDK sysroot) native assets added
bullets.detail: Pre-built native libraries for Linux Bionic targets (used in some embedded and cross-compiled Android NDK scenarios) are now included in the NuGet packages.

bullets.lead: Tizen x64 and arm64 native builds added
bullets.detail: The Tizen platform now ships x64 and arm64 native assets in addition to the existing armel build.
Library TFMs now use the versioned `26.0` moniker; app TFMs use the unversioned form. This aligns with Apple's recommended packaging and eliminates TFM resolution warnings.
Native WASM builds for Emscripten versions targeting pre-.NET 8 runtimes have been removed. .NET 8+ Emscripten builds remain.
Bundled native libraries were updated: libpng to 1.6.58, libexpat to 2.7.5, zlib to 1.3.2.1-motley, freetype to 2.14.3, libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1, expat to 2.8.1, and HarfBuzz to 14.2.0.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Singleton lifecycle rework, SKPath finalizer fix, default typeface resolution on Android, variable fonts, TreatWarningsAsErrors cleanup across the binding, and Uno/Skottie sample fixes
contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Linux Bionic native assets support and C# 13 PolySharp backport for legacy TFMs
contributor_summaries.ebariche: Fix for CI samples, Docker, NanoServer, coverlet, and the Cake build chain
contributor_summaries.sasakrsmanovic: Fix for WinUI Projection DLL not found on .NET 9
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: Fix for SKGLView not rendering after tab switch in MAUI TabBar on Android

preview_summaries.v4.148.0-rc.1.2: The release candidate finalized the Skia m148 upgrade, pixel-access stride and offset fixes, the singleton lifecycle rework, legacy paint-member errors, and the `SKNativeObject` setter removal.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.3.1: Preview 3 added the HBColor value type, missing API wrappers, TreatWarningsAsErrors cleanup, libjpeg-turbo and HarfBuzz updates, and CI improvements.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 introduced animated WebP encoding, the SKPath finalizer fix, corrected Apple platform TFMs, and zero-copy `SKStream.GetData()`.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the v4 line on Skia m132/m147: variable fonts, color font palettes, `SKSamplingOptions` on surface/canvas draw, Linux Bionic, Tizen native builds, and security-refreshed native libraries.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0 adds the `HBColor` value type for proper `hb_color_t` representation, gains variable font shaping support through the new SkiaSharp variable font APIs, and refreshes the bundled HarfBuzz library to 14.2.0.
